claimText: Democrats will win a majority of the total US House seats and US Senate seats contested in Texas in the 2026 midterm elections.
resolutionRules: This claim resolves YES if, following the 2026 midterm elections, the Democratic Party wins a majority of the total number of US House seats allocated to Texas and a majority of the US Senate seats contested in Texas. If only one US Senate seat is contested, winning that seat will count as a majority. Official election results reported by the Texas Secretary of State or a consensus of major news outlets (e.g., AP, Reuters, New York Times) will be used for resolution.
